fields.objection: Core shear is now screened against Hexcel Table II minimum-average and typical values with a stated quadratic interaction. Catalog plate-shear tests at 0.625-inch thickness do not qualify this curved 23.237-mm core, its density, adhesive, temperature, seams or scatter.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure L/W shear and crushing of the actual curved core/bond stack; establish installed allowables and a supported failure law.
fields.disposition: Computed conditional screen; qualification remains open

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
